activity_summary: Walking early, you said thirty-one to yourself, or Saturday if the font is believed over your mother. You set your father's house against a chamber, a cat, and a king half-made. You revised the banishment from six years to ten, with four given back. You had heard of the Garter trumpets and you were not near them. You told nobody the day.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the age, the house, the banishment and the comparison, alone.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Thirty-one, to the grass

facets.activity: Said the age to the grass and revised the sentence

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thirty-one. Or on Saturday, if the font's to be believed over my mother.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: At thirty-one my father was a chamberlain of the borough and had a house.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Six years. No, ten, and then he gives four back, like a man tipping a waiter.
